Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the child law, backing and driveway entry resolve to the first selected page, parked-position entry, roundabouts, lane choice and the start of lane changing to the second, the rest of lane changing and speed to the third, speed procedures and turns to the fourth, overtaking and passing to the fifth, parked cars, stopping and the start of brakes to the sixth, and emergency braking, brake care and downshifting to the seventh.

Confidence: high across the section; every procedure is printed directly on its page. The fourth selected page carries no printed folio in the snapshot's footer crop, so it is cited by its physical page only.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
